text:
Predicates:
Library(x) ::: x works in the library.
CS(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
Database(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedDavid(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
Lab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (Library(x) ∧ CS(x) → False) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (PartTimeJob(x) → Library(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (Database(x) → CS(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedDavid(x) → Database(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Lab(x) → InstructedDavid(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Lab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬PartTimeJob(jack) ∧ ¬Lab(jack) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬PartTimeJob(james) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
